ACryptoS is a DeFi protocol built on smart contracts on a public blockchain. ACryptoS offers decentralized crypto asset management services without a centralized intermediary.

Paraswap is a DeFi application built on smart contracts on public blockchains. Paraswap operates as a decentralized exchange aggregator that routes token trades across multiple liquidity sources. Paraswap executes swaps without a centralized intermediary.

Lido is a DeFi application built on smart contracts on the Ethereum public blockchain. Lido provides liquid staking, in which users receive tokens that represent their staked ether. Lido operates without a centralized intermediary and is governed through a decentralized autonomous organization.
